launch_032.objective: Establish exactly-once matching routing records immediately per completed response invocation and zero new records per invalid-arity invocation.
prerequisites: Root verifies review31 source closure against the manifest/test above, full manifest mode/size/hash and exact working parent, and budgets before dispatch. Changed parent requires rebinding; this plan cannot substitute for review31.

Worker uses read/edit/write only: no shell, imports, compilation, subprocesses, tests, candidate execution, provider invocation or delegation. Root freezes output and obtains fresh independent exact-revision review.
required_behavior: For matrix records, retain the last accepted bounded raw snapshot, initially empty. Immediately after every completed bounded_run, use unchanged collect_records, require the prior snapshot remains an exact prefix, and examine only the new suffix. Never accept truncation/replacement or let missing and duplicate records cancel across calls. Do not reset or truncate the cumulative file.

Each of nine response rows and the existing additional valid-review invocation must add exactly one complete JSONL record, with exact object equality against expected argv, workspace cwd and base64 review-fixture stdin. Reject malformed JSON, blank/extra/incomplete lines and content mismatch. Require zero added raw bytes for every existing invalid-arity call. Record row identity, expected/observed delta and routing outcome with its row; accept no row until routing and existing output/status checks pass. Check routing before a response mismatch can discard its observation. First mismatch aborts before any later bounded_run.

Preserve current arity rows, counts and valid-review call exactly for card33. Replace aggregate-only acceptance with per-invocation validation, including that additional valid-review call. Preserve response bytes/status expectations, collector bound and boundary controls, deadlines, ownership, cleanup, adapters and sandbox profile.

Add exactly two fixed public scenarios, routing-missing and routing-duplicate. Both enter the actual matrix response path and inject the fault into its first success response through generated fake output: respectively write zero records or two identical records while preserving normal stdout/stderr/status. Use literal, narrowly bounded fixture choices; no arbitrary count/config interface. Normal fixture mode still writes one record. Real adapters and fake process must run through unchanged bounded_run; never fabricate the observed record delta in the checker or call helpers directly.

Each negative control must exit nonzero for its first row's routing mismatch and never launch a subsequent row. Persist a tiny routing.json even on that expected failure: scenario, failing row, expected/observed delta, mismatch reason, attempted invocation count and that invocation's lifecycle state. Include enough bounded actual observation to establish missing versus duplicate. Receipt-write failure remains failure. Do not add general result.json or global invocation inventory now.

public_e2e_recipe.assertions: Matrix has one matching record per response/valid-review and zero per existing invalid arity. Missing/duplicate controls fail first success row with observed0/2 versus expected1, attempted count1, no later launch and independently confirmed cleanup.
